select.if:
SELECT '${statusValid}' statusValid, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, T1.PS cashType,
T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID,
nvl(SAI.SEC_ACCT_NAME, fp.FINPROD_NAME) secAcctName,
FPD.COLLECT_TYPE collectType, T1.FEE_AMT channelFee, NVL(T1.FPRICE_AMT,T1.TRADE_AMT) tradeAmtReal, CASE WHEN SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END channel,
T1.FINPROD_ID, T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T4.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, to_char(T1.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate/*计息开始日*/, to_char(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate/*计息结束日*/,
T3.UNIT_INT unitIntAmt/*单位应计利息*/, to_char(T4.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDateWhole/*起息日*/, to_char(T4.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDateWhole/*到期日*/, T3.UNIT_PRIN intPrinAmt/*单位本金*/, T3.PRIN prinAmt/*还本面额/百元*/, T3.RATE*100 yield/*区间票面利率（%）*/, to_char(T3.THEORY_PAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') payDate/*支付日*/, T3.THEORY_INT intAmtTheory/*理论应计利息*/, T3.THEORY_PRIN prinAmtTheory/*理论还本金额*/, T1.INT_AMT intAmt/*实收利息总额*/,
to_char(T1.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') TRADE_DATE/*资金到账日*/, T1.TRADE_MARKET_MODE tradeMarket, T1.SHARE_AMT qty, T3.THEORY_AMT fpriceAmt/*理论本息总额*/, T1.TRADE_AMT/*实收本息总额*/, T1.P_TRADE_ID pTradeId, t3.PA_BUSS_TYPE FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1
LEFT JOIN WFL_PA_TRD_FIN_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SAI ON T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON T1.CHL_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPD ON FP.FINPROD_ID=FPD.FINPROD_ID WHERE T4.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01} AND ((T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND T1.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N}) or (T1.P_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03}))

SELECT distinct
T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode,
T1.P_TRADE_ID busiCode,
T1.PS cashType,
T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID,
nvl(SAI.SEC_ACCT_NAME, fp.FINPROD_NAME) secAcctName,
FPD.COLLECT_TYPE collectType, T1.FEE_AMT channelFee, NVL(T1.FPRICE_AMT,T1.TRADE_AMT) tradeAmtReal, CASE WHEN SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END channel,
T1.FINPROD_ID, T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T4.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, to_char(T1.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate/*计息开始日*/, to_char(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate/*计息结束日*/,
T3.UNIT_INT unitIntAmt/*单位应计利息*/, to_char(T4.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDateWhole/*起息日*/, to_char(T4.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDateWhole/*到期日*/, T3.UNIT_PRIN intPrinAmt/*单位本金*/, T3.PRIN prinAmt/*还本面额/百元*/, T3.RATE*100 yield/*区间票面利率（%）*/, to_char(T3.THEORY_PAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') payDate/*支付日*/, T3.THEORY_INT intAmtTheory/*理论应计利息*/, T3.THEORY_PRIN prinAmtTheory/*理论还本金额*/, T1.INT_AMT intAmt/*实收利息总额*/, DEAL.CANCEL_REMARK revokeReason, to_char(T1.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') TRADE_DATE/*资金到账日*/, T1.TRADE_MARKET_MODE tradeMarket, T1.SHARE_AMT*100 qty, T3.THEORY_AMT fpriceAmt/*理论本息总额*/, T1.TRADE_AMT/*实收本息总额*/, T1.P_TRADE_ID pTradeId, t3.PA_BUSS_TYPE FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL DEAL ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SAI ON T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON T1.CHL_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPD ON FP.FINPROD_ID=FPD.FINPROD_ID WHERE T4.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01}
AND T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND T1.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N}
AND T1.P_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03}

SELECT cash_id, CASH_TYPE, PORTFOLIO_ID, PORTFOLIO_NAME, INVEST_YESORNO, FINPROD_ID, INV_AIM, HODING_TYPE, CDATE, SUM(AMOUNT) AMOUNT, vDate, mDate, decode(yield,'',null,yield) yield, CALC_RULE FROM ( SELECT listagg(t5.CASH_TYPE, ',') within group ( order by t5.CASH_ID ) CASH_TYPE, listagg(t5.CASH_ID, ',') within group ( order by t5.CASH_ID ) CASH_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, pp.INVEST_YESORNO, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.INV_AIM,/*债券必须有投资目的，这个用来区分融入和其他*/ T1.HODING_TYPE, T1.CDATE, DECODE(T1.HODING_TYPE, '06', T1.AMOUNT*-1, T1.AMOUNT) AMOUNT, '${vDate}' vDate, '${mDate}' mDate, '${yield}' yield, /*现金流支付规则.支付频率 付息周期*/ T4.PAY_CYCLE CALC_RULE /*检索对象 组合持仓*/ FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION T1 /*left join 标的类金融产品*/ LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 /*on 组合持仓.金融产品代码 = 标的类金融产品.金融产品代码*/ ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID /*left join 现金流信息*/ LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T3 /*on 标的类金融产品.金融产品代码 = 现金流信息.业务代码*/ ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID /*and 现金流信息.现金流一级类型 = 数据字典缓存.现金流一级类型.利息*/ AND T3.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_02} /*and 现金流信息.现金流二级类型 = 数据字典缓存.现金流二级类型.利息*/ AND T3.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C02} /*left join 现金流支付规则*/ LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE T4 /*on 现金流信息.现金流代码 = 现金流支付规则.现金流代码*/ ON T3.CASH_ID = T4.CASH_ID /*and 生效日期 小于等于 传参.调整后计算结束日*/ AND T4.EFF_DATE <= #{adjustMDate} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T5 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID AND T5.MDATE = #{adjustMDate} LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID /*检索条件 金融产品代码 = 传参.金融产品代码*/ where T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} /*and 持仓类型 = 数据字典缓存.持仓类型.实际*/ AND T1.HODING_TYPE IN ('03', '05', '06') /*and 组合持仓.日期 = 平台日*/ AND t1.CDATE < #{adjustMDate} AND T1.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId} and T1.AMOUNT > 0 AND nvl(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,'null') = 'null'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION tpsp where tpsp.HODING_TYPE = T1.HODING_TYPE and tpsp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID and tpsp.SEC_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID and tpsp.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID and tpsp.CDATE > T1.CDATE and tpsp.CDATE < #{adjustMDate} ) /*不存在生效的交易*/ and NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TPDA LEFT JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON TPDA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where TDTA.MP_FINPROD_ID IS NULL AND TPDA.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND TPDA.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} and TO_DATE(#{mDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TPDA.MDATE AND TPDA.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID =TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID AND ((TPDA.CHL_ID is NULL and t1.sec_acct_id='999999') OR TPDA.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID)) /*不存在流程中的当期或之前的交易*/ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TPDA LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON TPDA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where TDTA.MP_FINPROD_ID IS NULL AND TPDA.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND TPDA.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} and TO_DATE(#{mDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TPDA.MDATE AND TPDA.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID =TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID AND ((TPDA.CHL_ID is NULL and t1.sec_acct_id='999999') OR TPDA.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID))
group by pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.FINPROD_ID, PP.INVEST_YESORNO, T1.INV_AIM, T1.HODING_TYPE, T1.CDATE, T1.AMOUNT, T4.PAY_CYCLE order by AMOUNT ) where AMOUNT > 0 group by cash_id, CASH_TYPE, PORTFOLIO_ID, PORTFOLIO_NAME, INVEST_YESORNO, FINPROD_ID, INV_AIM, HODING_TYPE, CDATE, vDate, mDate, yield, CALC_RULE
